Each question costs far less than an agentic task. Reasoning: short logic, spatial and theory-of-mind questions, each with a single correct answer, graded against ground truth. Each question costs far less than an agentic task. Models run at their highest supported effort setting. Where a different setting is shown, the model's name carries it: Claude Fable 5.2 is shown at xhigh because its max-effort run scored lower overall (84.2 at max against 84.9), behind on Long Agentic, Data Analysis, Research and Design and ahead on Browser Use, Reasoning and Coding. Overall is the mean of the suites a model has a score for. Blank and n/a cells are left out. Every suite counts equally. Publication release date, not per-model run date. No direct Windows RE or creative problem-solving validation.
